purpose: Support Chapter 9 without inventing a single scalar adequacy order. Each row imports the source-owned proved condition for one scientific responsibility and records the monotone shortcut it replaces.
claim_ceiling: This matrix is not a theorem that every notion of richer information lowers adequacy.
Rows use different carriers, estimands, contracts, and comparison orders and therefore may not be pooled into one scalar effect or one global partial order.
The safe synthesis claim is that no one listed richness proxy is privileged as an automatic certificate of adequacy across the dissertation's distinct scientific responsibilities.
TU-1 remains the exact theorem for revision after compression; Chapters 1-8 retain theorem and evidence ownership in their source repositories.
A row is admitted only when its proved condition matches the corresponding entry in thesis/proved_condition_registry.json.

rows.richness_proxy: more biologically proximal, precise, or numerous observations
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: richer observation => closer identification of the latent mechanism
rows.proved_condition: For exact compatible log-linear observations Mx=y, compatible-set dimension is k-rank(M); one new scalar observation reduces ambiguity if and only if its row is outside the current row span, in which case the dimension falls by exactly one.
rows.decisive_application: The product-chain k-1-r rule is a corollary; repeated, rescaled, or linearly redundant observations do not change structural rank.
rows.safe_conclusion: Identification improves when the observation operator gains an independent direction, not because observational richness increases in an untyped sense.

rows.richness_proxy: more reproducible or universal-looking lead-before-loss ordering among event trajectories
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: more consistent precedence => stronger predictive warning validity
rows.proved_condition: For a binary common-horizon marker, perfect event-conditioned precedence forces sensitivity=1 but leaves non-event specificity free; binary-marker AUC=(1+specificity)/2, so the same perfect precedence is compatible with AUC from 0.5 to 1. All non-events firing gives the sharp chance-discrimination endpoint specificity=0 and AUC=0.5.
rows.decisive_application: The locked ensembles realize the sharp endpoint: 35/35 event leads with 48/48 non-event firings and 33/33 event leads with 49/49 non-event firings.
rows.safe_conclusion: Temporal precedence identifies event sensitivity under this binary horizon contract but does not identify specificity or discrimination.

rows.richness_proxy: more available measurable variables or a fixed precommitted measurement list
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: more measurable variables => more useful mechanism resolution; measurement order is neutral
rows.proved_condition: Adaptive second-step value E[max_q U_q(X)] is at least max_q E[U_q(X)], with equality if and only if at least one candidate is branchwise optimal on every positive-probability first-outcome branch; strict advantage occurs if and only if the intersection of branchwise argmax sets is empty.
rows.decisive_application: A minimal deterministic four-world witness gives adaptive second-step value 1.0 bit versus 0.5 bits for the best precommitted static second candidate; G2 separately validates the full method against random ordering.
rows.safe_conclusion: Adaptive measurement ordering has strict value exactly when first outcomes create incompatible branchwise optima; recomputation is not universally beneficial.

rows.richness_proxy: one increasingly detailed scalar eco-genetic summary used as a universal state descriptor
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: a richer common summary => adequate representation of every target-relevant state
rows.proved_condition: For a finite set of target vectors oriented so higher is no worse, an exact directionally coherent sufficient scalar exists if and only if the distinct target vectors form a chain under coordinatewise product order.
rows.decisive_application: The locked H3 2-patch versus 16-patch target vectors cross: retained interaction and local effective size decrease while realised high-trait mass increases, violating the chain condition.
rows.safe_conclusion: A common directional scalar is possible exactly on chain-ordered target sets; target crossings are exact impossibility certificates.

rows.richness_proxy: static physical/local interface width used as a proxy for required causal memory
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: narrower physical boundary => smaller exact future-response memory
rows.proved_condition: Decoder addressability gives a cross-grammar information lower bound; the fixed-regular relay family attains K_open-K_closed=m with fixed primitive alphabet, bounded degree, one-edge focal cut, and bounded local alphabets. Separate coherence conditions give sufficient positive portability criteria.
rows.decisive_application: The closed quotient has 2 classes while the open quotient has 2^(m+1), attaining the finite-domain m-bit innovation bound under fixed local/static resource constants.
rows.safe_conclusion: Static physical locality alone does not upper-bound open-future exact response memory; coherent shared macro dynamics provide a separate positive portability boundary.

rows.responsibility_type: required state and monitoring under capability expansion
rows.richness_proxy: size of the newly admitted intervention repertoire or viable-carrier gain
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: smaller capability gain => smaller representation and monitoring burden
rows.proved_condition: For every m>=1 there is one connected finite system where adding one action increases the robust carrier by exactly one world but refines a retained present slice from one to 2^m states and creates exactly m bits of monitoring debt; therefore no finite upper bound depending only on carrier-size gain can bound required resolution.
rows.decisive_application: The same construction keeps a declared coarse target deterministically reportable while full required-state identification becomes unlicensed under unchanged evidence.
rows.safe_conclusion: Capability gain, required state resolution, monitoring burden, and target reportability are different quantities and need not scale together.

rows.richness_proxy: confidence in or exactness of an accepted source macro-law
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: a law that is exact at the source => the same law remains exact after structural replacement
rows.proved_condition: The carried partition is exact if and only if output, legal-action rows and successor carried labels are constant within carried fibers; iterative refinement gives the unique coarsest exact source-relative repair; across routes, one immutable history mode per distinct carried terminal map is necessary and sufficient to preserve all inherited label semantics.
rows.decisive_application: Distinct carried terminal maps cannot share one inherited history mode even when their unlabeled repaired partition shapes can coincide.
rows.safe_conclusion: Source exactness licenses target reuse only under explicit operational coherence; source-relative repair and history have exact minimal forms when coherence fails.

rows.richness_proxy: more repeated observations under the same failure architecture or more independent modes at the same raw effort
rows.forbidden_monotone_inference: more repeats => uniformly stronger evidence; alternatively, more failure diversity => uniformly stronger evidence
rows.proved_condition: With two reads per present coordinate, equal mode availability a, per-read sensitivity p, independent modes and no false positives, two one-read independent modes beat one mode with two repeats for joint detection of k coordinates if and only if p>2-2^(1/k); deeper repetition wins below the threshold and they tie at it.
rows.decisive_application: For fixed m modes, unlimited within-mode repetition still cannot raise the uniform worst-case guarantee above 1-(1-a)^m; finite effort and asymptotic effort therefore have distinct depth-versus-diversity constraints.
rows.safe_conclusion: Evidence allocation has an explicit sensitivity-by-target-size boundary and a separate failure-mode availability ceiling; neither raw repeats nor mode count is universally privileged.

synthesis_rule.permitted: Across these typed scientific responsibilities, none of the recorded richness proxies is an automatic certificate of adequacy; each chapter instead supplies a condition specifying when the relevant reuse, refinement, design, or report is licensed.
synthesis_rule.forbidden: Do not infer a universal scalar law that more detail, more measurement, more memory, more intervention, or more repetition always increases or decreases adequacy.
synthesis_rule.exact_substrate: TU-1 separately proves the same-carrier factorization criterion and exact revision debt after compression; the eight source-owned rows remain distinct proved conditions, not special cases of TU-1.
